assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate a BRAND NEW square app-icon illustration from TEXT ONLY for the travel-language app 咕游记. No input images, no editing previous artwork. Two original anime bird mascots equally large, equal eye-line and approximately equal crown height, side-by-side head-and-chest closeup filling most of square. BLUE Gugu left, PURPLE Gaga right. Both are independent equal companions.

STYLE: sophisticated shallow satin-enamel bas-relief with Japanese anime facial drawing. Smooth lightly raised pastel planes, finely restrained bevels, soft consistent daylight, expressive simple drawn anime eyes with one small catchlight. Not fuzzy/plush, not photoreal birds, not heavy plastic sculpture. Premium yet cute. Light sky blue, pale lavender, warm ivory, muted apricot, restrained blue-gray and sage scenery. Few meaningful feather planes, no extravagant decorations. Full-bleed opaque SQUARE, no pre-rounded cutout, no text, logos or borders outside image.

BLUE GUGU: round bean-shaped head, compact single comma CURL feather on crown (not a giant handle), ivory facial lobes that surround the eyes and connect to ivory breast, rounded blue anime eyes, small POINTED apricot bird beak, tapered blue wing with one small ivory oval feather inset. Cheerful soft nerdy playful character: one eye winking in joyful innocence, other bright and open, little delighted open-beak smile. No half-lidded leering or smug grin. Its little wing rests naturally near lower edge, no props.

PURPLE GAGA: softly pentagonal head with small upturned cheek feather corners, TWO short neat leaf-shaped crown feathers, PURPLE UPPER FACE INCLUDING THE AREA AROUND THE EYES, ivory LOWER cheek bib and breast. Violet slightly almond-shaped anime eyes. Small BROADER BLUNT rounded duck-like bill, not the same pointed beak as blue. Small rounded wing. More composed and proud character, slightly assertive, genuinely warm and easily flustered under the poise.

GAGA'S FACIAL EXPRESSION IS THE MAIN PRIORITY: noticeably stronger CLASSIC ANIME TSUNDERE with BOTH haughty pride AND vulnerable endearing blush. It must be immediately readable as a puffed-cheek 'hmph! It's not like I was looking forward to this trip with you!' without written dialogue.
- Chin a little raised, head turns perhaps 8 degrees outward, but pupils sneak a glance back toward blue companion.
- One eyebrow elegantly raised, other slightly pinched in flustered pride. Eyes remain large and soft with visible irises, NOT narrow sultry half-lidded slits or contemptuous dead stare.
- BOTH cream cheeks visibly PUFFED, one slightly fuller, round and squishy, a clear cheek-puff deformation rather than normal cheek volume. Tiny CLOSED broad bill pursed forward in a rounded pout. It should be a stylized BIRD pout, no human lips, lipstick or teeth.
- Warm pink blush clearly visible on BOTH cheeks, a few very fine anime blush hatch marks; blush says embarrassed delight, not sexy makeup.
- One small wing folded against its OWN chest at bottom edge and the other at its own flank. Absolutely no clinging, grabbing blue, leaning on blue, helpless pleading, crying or coquettish posture.
The overall emotion is 'proud but blushing because it secretly loves being here', not angry villain, cold contempt, seductive smirk, or submissive spouse. Blue is joyfully comfortable beside Gaga. No hearts, steam clouds, angry symbols, crowns or jewelry.

BACKGROUND: coherent SCENIC TRAIN JOURNEY. Behind both birds is ONE wide horizontal passenger-train window with simple rounded corners and a modest warm ivory frame, subtle slate-blue inset seal. Birds are inside the carriage in front of the window. Outside, a continuous calm lake, curved sage wooded shoreline and distant blue-gray mountains under pale clear sky. Render the window and scenery in the SAME restrained soft-relief anime material family, not a photograph pasted behind stickers. Keep landscape to a few broad elegant layers and lower contrast than faces, no detailed buildings or tiny landmarks, no abstract globe grid. The window occupies entire background with correct occlusion behind birds. Soft frontal daylight with window ambient fill unifies birds and scenery.

COMPOSITION: both crowns start at approximately 15-20% image height, both eyes at approximately 60% image height, faces roughly same size and equal importance, both crests fully visible, lower chests cropped at bottom. Characters combined occupy about 90% width and 80% height. Scenery is a subordinate band above and between heads, not a huge empty top half. Preserve character silhouette differences even in this close crop. One icon, not a sheet, not multiple views.
